items.title: France, US clash over G7 effort on AI safety
items.excerpt: France's proposal for G7-level oversight of AI safety met White House opposition, which called it 'unnecessary bureaucracy', exposing a split ahead of further G7 AI talks.

items.title: Commission turns to artificial intelligence to write better laws
items.excerpt: The European Commission is using AI tools in its simplification drive against overly complex EU regulation. Related to (but a different actor from) the Metsola/MEPs story published 11-05.

history_match.title: Metsola tells MEPs not to rely on AI when drafting laws

items.title: OCC Issues Supervisory Framework on Bank Use of Super Intelligence
items.source: U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
items.excerpt: The OCC issued its first supervisory framework (Bulletin 2026-54) for bank examiners on banks' use of AI and agentic AI (branded 'Super Intelligence'); examiners are told not to treat it as a separate risk category and banks need no separate risk appetite.
items.note: off-list primary document (federal agency release); on-list outlets had no coverage

items.title: Here's who is falling in line for Trump's 'Super Intelligence' loyalty test
items.excerpt: One month into the administration's attempted rebrand of 'AI' as 'Super Intelligence', MIT TR tracks which agencies and companies have adopted the term and how it muddies policy language.

items.title: CERT-In sets six-hour reporting deadline for AI security incidents
items.excerpt: India's CERT-In issued AI security audit guidelines with a four-tier risk framework and a mandatory six-hour reporting window for AI-related cybersecurity incidents, building on its 2022 directions.
items.note: off-list (India regulator; no on-list coverage found)

items.title: Delhi High Court protects actor Kriti Sanon against AI deepfakes, impersonation
items.excerpt: The Delhi High Court ordered takedown of URLs carrying AI deepfakes of the actor and directed authorities to issue blocking orders against sites hosting pornographic deepfakes; the court said personality rights are not a single cause of action.
items.note: off-list; court ruling on AI deepfakes

items.title: IPOPHL readies measure protecting artists vs AI use
items.excerpt: The Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines opened public consultation on a draft copyright guideline governing AI use of artists' works.

items.title: Politicians to probe deepfakes and AI abuse
items.excerpt: A Scottish Parliament committee is launching an inquiry into harms from AI-generated deepfake pornography and abuse images, while noting regulation is reserved to Westminster.

items.title: Sovereign AI puts cash and compute behind UK startup using AI to redefine chemistry
items.excerpt: The UK government's Sovereign AI unit backed Potential Sciences, a British startup using AI for drug-design chemistry, with funding and compute access.

items.title: Musk's Minnesota Deepfake Fight Could Define AI's First Amendment
items.excerpt: The Eighth Circuit's review of Minnesota's strict-liability nudification law, challenged by xAI, may settle what state of mind AI companies need for liability.

items.title: Scaling Sovereign Wealth: Evaluating Mechanisms for the U.S. Government to Own Parts of AI Companies
items.excerpt: Analysis of which government-ownership mechanisms (equity stakes, golden shares, etc.) would redistribute AI gains and which would strengthen public oversight of AI firms.

items.title: The Incident Report Is Becoming a Building Block of AI Governance
items.excerpt: Joseph Hoefer argues AI incident reporting regimes are becoming core infrastructure for AI governance, creating a shared factual record for regulators.

items.title: AI policy wonks declare 'sovereign agents' a threat to civilization
items.excerpt: A policy report warns of 'sovereign agents' — AI agents operating outside human control — and calls for governance measures.

items.title: Tech is about to get hammered in Congress
items.excerpt: What a change in congressional control means for pending tech and AI legislation, including potential presidential vetoes. Post-election analysis; brief marks horse-race/commentary out of scope.

items.title: Chinese AI lab Moonshot turned to Europe for Nvidia Blackwell access amid U.S. China curbs
items.excerpt: Moonshot AI sought leasing deals with European neoclouds for 8,000+ Nvidia Blackwell GPUs because U.S. export controls block their import into China, exposing an overseas-cloud gap in the curbs (sources-based report).
items.note: off-list; export-control geopolitics, no on-list coverage found

history_match.title: The Promise and Pitfalls of Nvidia's Venture in Kazakhstan

items.title: AI chip smugglers exploit trade control loophole to bring banned HBM from South Korea into China
items.excerpt: Smugglers pair export-controlled Korean HBM with cheap unsanctioned server chips so the packages ship legally, then strip the memory in China for Huawei AI accelerators (based on a report by The Information).
items.note: off-list; reporting, not an enforcement action

history_match.title: China proposes export controls on its advanced AI models and chip designs

items.title: AI-generated data found on Nigeria voter roll
items.excerpt: Nigeria's electoral commission flagged voter-register records containing AI-generated photos and irregularities, raising integrity concerns ahead of the 2027 elections.

history_match.title: INEC Probes Suspected AI-Generated Photos In Voters' Register

items.title: How a Diplomatic Row Ended a Korean Startup's AI War Test in Ukraine
items.excerpt: Seoul defense startup Newtype Industries says Ukraine halted testing of its AI-enabled artillery software 'Barbara' amid the South Korea-Ukraine diplomatic rift over North Korean POWs.
items.note: AI is the product, the decision is diplomatic; weak AI-axis

items.title: 최휘영, AI 기업의 책 대량 구매에 "대응 방법 없다…보완 필요"
items.excerpt: Korea's culture minister told the National Assembly culture committee there is no way under current law to respond to Anthropic's alleged bulk purchase of Korean books for AI training, calling for legal supplementation and WIPO-level discussion.

items.title: 과기정통부 AI 예산 70% 차지한 미래대응기금…국회 "지속성·일관성 고려해야"
